comparison.objective: Orient and seal a gel-casting tray and insert a comb, not tune an industrial damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Tray orientation, gasket compression/alignment, and comb-slot insertion versus hex-key alignment, collar micro-rotation, counterholding, and tightening.
comparison.success_condition: Tray crosswise with end gaskets sealing and comb in an end slot; no spec versions or numeric leak/alignment rubric are available. Candidate requires measured cyclic mechanical response.
comparison.reason: Sealing and insert placement are different tested outcomes from dynamic damping adjustment.
